title: terminalia myrtifolia
intro: Terminalia myrtifolia, commonly known as the Myrtan or Nerium, is a flowering plant in the family Combretaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, that may help alleviate symptoms of fever, cold, and cough. The therapeutic actions of Terminalia myrtifolia are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive constituents are believed to contribute to the plant's antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
